jobs.title: Director, Systems & Platform Integration, FCC
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**You will be working on a 100% remote schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement.**

 **Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings.**

  

At Fidelity, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services \- and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future.

  

Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best \- both personally and professionally.

 **How You’ll Make an Impact**


The Director, Systems \& Platform Integration will lead FCC’s capability for connecting the systems, platforms, vendors, services, and data flows that support Fidelity Clearing Canada’s business. FCC operates in a regulated clearing and brokerage environment serving introducing brokers, portfolio managers, and institutional/intermediary clients. This role owns the integration layer across FCC’s APIs, services, messages, files, data interfaces, vendor/client platform connections, workflows, reporting, operations, and enterprise services, while aligning with Fidelity Canada, FIL, and broader enterprise standards where relevant.

* Integrate clients, platforms, vendors, enterprise services, APIs, messages, files, and data feeds securely and reliably.
* Keep FCC’s clearing, brokerage, client, reporting, reconciliation, and operational flows auditable, monitored, recoverable, and ready for growth.
* Move FCC toward reusable integration standards, stronger automation, AI enablement, operational digitization, scalable platform capabilities, and alignment with Fidelity Canada, FIL, and FCC\-specific needs.
* Provide senior client\-facing leadership for organizations integrating with FCC, building trusted relationships with client technology and business representatives and ensuring that integration requirements, solution options, responsibilities, risks, timelines, testing, cutover readiness, and support expectations are clearly understood and effectively managed.
* Own a roadmap balancing modernization, workflow automation, AI enablement, operational digitization, enterprise integration, resiliency, risk reduction, cost, and delivery trade\-offs.
* All direct reports have clear performance expectations, regular coaching, development plans, and succession or cross\-training coverage for critical capabilities.

 **What We’re Looking For**

* University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7\+ years of technology management and leadership experience in financial services, clearing, brokerage, wealth, custody, banking, capital markets, or another regulated transaction\-processing environment.
* Strong experience leading systems/platform integration, APIs, services, messaging, files, batch, data feeds, vendor connectivity, client\-facing platform delivery, and modern integration platforms such as Solace, Boomi, Kafka, MuleSoft, IBM MQ/App Connect, AWS/Azure Integration Services, or similar tools.
* Demonstrated technical leadership in integration architecture, solution design, design reviews, non\-functional requirements, production readiness, and technical risk decisions.
* Demonstrated experience in a client\-facing leadership role, working directly with external clients and senior stakeholders
* Experience leading teams of architects, analysts, technical leads, integration specialists, etc.,

 **The Skill Set You Bring**

* Experience using AI\-assisted development, automation, analytics insight, developer productivity tooling, and enterprise integration capabilities is an asset
* Experience governing integration standards for service contracts, data mappings, API design, event flows, file exchanges, error handling, monitoring, logging, auditability, and support handoff.
* Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud\-enabled architecture, production reliability, observability, incident/problem/change
* Technically credible and engineering\-first \- understands APIs, services, messages, files, event streaming, iPaaS, ESB, data flows, system dependencies, production support, architecture, standards, integration tools such as Solace, Boomi, Kafka, MuleSoft or similar platforms, automation, developer productivity, and technical risk.
* Understands clearing, brokerage, reporting, reconciliation, regulatory, service quality, and operational impacts.
* Architecturally minded, modernization oriented, and operationally disciplined \- drives reusable standards, scalable integration capability, monitoring, controls, recoverability, cybersecurity, auditability, resilience, and production stability.
* Strong client\-facing, relationship\-management, presentation, and communication skills, with the credibility to lead technical discussions, explain trade\-offs, resolve issues, and build confidence with clients, partners, and senior executives.
* Enterprise\-aligned portfolio integrator \- connects FCC priorities with Fidelity Canada, FIL, enterprise technology direction, modernization, AI enablement, operational digitization, and BAU stability.

 **Some of the ways we’ll help you feel valued and supported as part of our team:**

* Flexible working arrangements that vary based on role requirements
* Competitive total compensation, including company contributions to your group RRSP without a matching requirement from you
* Comprehensive health benefits that start on your first day, with 100% employer\

jobs.title: Senior Director, Finance - Mississauga (Skymark)
jobs.description:
### **Our Mission:**


Ontario Medical Supply is a Leading Distributor of medical equipment, supplies, and services for healthcare organizations and home healthcare clients across Ontario. Specializing in long term care, assisted living, retirement and home health care. Ontario Medical Supply is partnered for success with Royal Drugs. Royal Drugs is a healthcare company providing specialty pharmacy, infusion therapy, and retail pharmacy services. Together, we work towards supporting optimal health outcomes and better quality of life.
  

  

Come Join Our Team!
### **Purpose:**


Reporting to the CFO, the Senior Director, Finance is a managerial role who oversees financial matters for our companies. With a hands\-on approach to all aspects of an organization’s finances, the successful candidate will be responsible for the financial activities of the organization to maximize a company’s profits and plan for its growth. The role includes analyzing data and advising the CEO and CFO on ways to use that information to make strategic decisions about the organization’s future.
  

  

Position: Senior Director, Finance
  

Location: Ontario Medical Supply. – Mississauga (2785 Skymark Ave, Mississauga, ON L4W 4Y3\),
  

No. of Positions: 1
  

ATR:\#5251
  

Type: Full Time, Permanent
  

Salary: $140,000\-190,000/year
### **Job Responsibilities:**


\-Provide leadership to the financial reporting team in a fast\-paced, efficient work environment in order to meet deliverables \- high\-quality, accurate and time\-sensitive output.
  

* Collaborate with FP\&A team to ensure consistent reporting and processes across the portfolio companies.
* Review financial processes and policies across portfolio companies to ensure accurate and consistent consolidation of financial reporting.
* Prepare reporting packages to executive leadership and Board of Directors.
* Reviewing and advising on legal agreements as required, while considering impacts on other areas (insurance, leasing, credit agreements, supply agreements etc).
* Developing reporting packages and forecast models used for raising capital.
* Overseeing company compliance with various regulations and legislation.
* Managing the end\-to\-end aspects and preparing memos for strategic projects, including data gathering, cross functional collaboration, communicating issues and management of those issues with key stakeholders.
* Knowledge of the following areas is beneficial: mergers and acquisitions, contracts, consolidation, inventory management, treasury.
### **Qualifications:**


* University degree supplemented by a Canadian professional accounting designation or a similar designation (e.g. CPA, CA; MBA).
* 7\-10 years of progressive experience in financial and business management.
* Strong writing skills to produce business cases, reports, briefings, and requirements documentation.
* Experience in review of legal documents and contracts.
* Demonstrated experience leveraging strong verbal, and communication skills to prepare and deliver presentations, including senior executives.

### **Skills:**


* Ability to work independently to achieve results yet still able to maintain a collaborative approach when required.
* Ability to manage deadlines.
* Proficient in Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Excellent research and analytical skills to participate in the review of current practices/processes, and the development of new processes, to assess impacts of changes on the organization and external stakeholders.
* Highly developed business acumen.

### **Human Resources:**


While we thank you for your interest, only select applicants will be contacted regarding the position.
  

  

Ontario Medical Supply is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer committed to providing diversity and accommodations for applicants upon request at any stage of the recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and the Ontario Human Rights Code. jobs.title: Senior Director, Capital Markets Finance
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**What You’ll Be Doing**

  

As Senior Director, Capital Markets Finance, you will report to and act as a senior advisor the Capital Markets CFO, supporting the broader CFO mandate across financial performance, strategic planning, resource allocation, decision support and transformation. You will bring together strong financial and Capital Markets expertise with a technology and innovation mindset to improve how Capital Markets Finance operates, generates insights and supports business decisions.

  

  

A key part of the mandate will be to modernize and automate financial reporting and analytical processes across the Capital Markets CFO teams, identify high\-value AI and technology use cases, and lead their implementation in partnership with Finance, Technology and the business. You will remain closely connected to developments in financial markets and the external environment, proactively identifying emerging risks, opportunities and implications for Capital Markets performance and strategy.

  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.*

  

**How You’ll Succeed**

  

* **Financial Performance and Insights** – Consolidate information across Capital Markets LOBs to provide a holistic view of performance, risk and opportunities. Provide forward\-looking analysis across revenue, expenses, balance sheet, capital, liquidity, RWA and other key financial resources. Connect financial results, business drivers and market developments to identify trends, opportunities and emerging risks and provide actionable insights to senior management.
* **Planning and Forecasting** – Lead the consolidation of LOB forecasts and plans, ensuring they are reasonable, aligned with Capital Markets strategy and positioned to deliver key financial and performance objectives. Challenge key business, market and regulatory assumptions and support effective resource allocation and execution.
* **Finance Transformation, Technology \& AI** \- Lead the modernization of Capital Markets Finance by identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate reporting, forecasting and analytical processes. Identify and lead high\-value AI, data and technology use cases from concept through implementation, adoption and measurable outcomes.
* **Markets Insight** \- Maintain a strong understanding of financial markets, macroeconomic developments, client activity, competitive dynamics and emerging industry trends. Translate external developments into implications for Capital Markets performance, risks, opportunities and strategic priorities.
* **Leadership and Governance** \- Maintain strong financial governance and controls while leading and developing a high\-performing Finance team. Set clear priorities, build capabilities, foster collaboration and create an environment of accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.
  

**Who You Are**

  

* **You act like an owner.** You thrive when you're empowered to take the lead, go above and beyond, and deliver results.
* **You're passionate about people.** You find meaning in relationships, and surround yourself with a diverse network of partners. You build trust through respect and authenticity
* **You're driven by collective success.** You know that collaboration can transform a good idea into a great one. You understand the power of an inclusive team that enjoys working together to bring a shared vision to life.
* **You give meaning to data.** You enjoy investigating complex problems, and making sense of information. You're confident in your ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way.
* **You can demonstrate** a minimum of 5 years working experience in a Finance leadership role, have a professional accounting designation and/or a post graduate business degree, along with good financial accounting knowledge and the ability to comprehend complex accounting issues and summarize them for the business. You also have strong problem solving, analytical, judgment and change implementation capabilities. In addition, you are equally comfortable with Finance and technology. You understand complex financial concepts but also have the curiosity and technical fluency to challenge how work is done and identify where automation, data and AI can fundamentally improve it.
* **You live your values.** You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.
  

\#LI\-TA


**What CIBC Offers**

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.


* We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program\*, defined benefit pension plan\*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
* Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
* We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

jobs.title: Director, Machine Learning
jobs.description:
**Narvar** is Growing! **We're looking for a leader to own the machine learning systems behind post\-purchase commerce — identity, fraud, and the intelligence layer that agentic AI runs on.**



Hundreds of millions of consumers interact with Narvar every year, across 20B\+ orders and 1,300\+ retail brands. That data powers three systems: **Graphite**, our identity resolution engine that ties fragmented consumer data into a single verified identity across retailers; **IRIS**, our fraud and returns\-abuse detection engine built on top of it.



You'll own the ML organization behind all of it — the models, the platform they run on, and the people who build them. This is a role for someone who wants a system with real consequences: fraud decisions that move retailer margin, identity resolution that agents make automated decisions on, and an adversary on the other side who adapts every quarter.

  

For this role, you should be located in Canada and able to work within EST/EDT OR PST hours. We are fully remote.


**Day\-to\-day**
----------------


* Own the ML charter across identity resolution, fraud and abuse detection, risk scoring, and consumer intelligence — strategy, roadmap, and delivery
* Build and grow a high\-performing, globally distributed team of ML engineers; hire, coach, and develop senior ICs and managers
* Set the technical bar for how models get built, evaluated, deployed, and monitored — and hold the org to it
* Push identity resolution coverage, precision, and profile classification accuracy against a measured, frozen\-holdout baseline — not against vibes
* Own IRIS model performance end\-to\-end: detection rate, false\-positive rate, label quality, and the feedback loops that keep both honest as fraud patterns shift
* Build the ML platform layer — feature stores, training pipelines, model registry, online serving, drift and performance monitoring — so model velocity isn't bottlenecked on infrastructure
* Partner with the AI engineering team so identity and risk signals are first\-class inputs to NAVI's agent decisions
* Work directly with Product, Engineering, Security, and Customer Success to translate messy retailer problems into ML problems worth solving — and to say no to the ones that aren't
* Own build\-vs\-buy and data\-partner decisions (third\-party identity data, enrichment providers), including the economics
* Communicate model performance, risk, and tradeoffs credibly to executives, retailers, and the board

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------



We care more about **judgment and ownership** than credentials.



You're likely a strong fit if you:


* Have 12\+ years in engineering with 5\+ years managing ML or data teams, including managing managers or senior ICs
* Are an engineer at heart — you can still read a training pipeline, review a feature spec, and tell when an eval is measuring the wrong thing
* Have shipped ML systems that make consequential automated decisions in production, and have owned them after launch — drift, retraining, incidents, and all
* Have deep experience with at least one of: **entity resolution / identity graphs**, **fraud and abuse detection**, **risk scoring**, or **anomaly detection at scale**
* Understand what makes ML different from software: labels are noisy and delayed, systems fail silently, offline metrics lie, and last quarter's model is fighting last quarter's adversary
* Have opinions about evaluation — precision/recall tradeoffs on heavily imbalanced data, holdout hygiene, feedback loops where the model's own decisions contaminate future labels
* Have built or scaled ML infrastructure: feature pipelines, training orchestration, online model serving with real latency budgets, monitoring and alerting
* Are fluent in Python and comfortable in a modern data stack (Spark, Airflow or equivalent, streaming, cloud data warehouses — we run on GCP)
* Have hired well, retained well, and can point to engineers whose careers got better on your watch
* Excel in a fast\-paced environment with a flat structure — you set direction by earning trust, not by mandate
* Have a BS/MS in computer science, statistics, or an equivalent background

**Bonus points**
----------------



These aren't hard requirements, but strong indicators:


* You've worked on identity resolution or graph systems against third\-party consumer data (credit bureau, telecom, or similar), including the matching logic and confidence scoring underneath
* You've operated adversarial ML systems where attackers actively adapt to your detection
* You've built real\-time inference paths where identity or risk has to be resolved inside a request budget
* You've worked in retail, payments, fintech, insurance, or marketplace trust \& safety
* You've partnered closely with LLM/agent teams and understand how structured ML signals ground agentic decisions
* You've navigated privacy, consent, and data\-governance constraints on consumer identity data
* You've done 01 — stood up a function, a platform, or a data partnership from nothing
* You use modern tooling (including AI\-assisted development workflows) to increase leverage, not outsource thinking

**Why ML at Narvar?**
---------------------



Because the data is genuinely rare and the problems are genuinely hard.


* **The dataset is a moat.** Cross\-retailer visibility across 20B\+ orders means we can see coordinated fraud patterns no single retailer can — a returns abuser hitting five brands looks like a good customer at each one.
* **The problem is adversarial and unsolved.** Returns fraud and policy abuse are growing faster than retail itself, and the counterparty adapts. There is no off\-the\-shelf answer.
* **The stakes are measurable.** Fraud loss, false\-positive cost, identity coverage, resolution rate. Not vanity metrics.
* **It feeds something bigger.** As AI shopping agents enter commerce, every agent will need a trust layer for returns, claims, and delivery promises. Identity and risk are that

jobs.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
jobs.description:
Questrade Financial Group (QFG), through its companies \- Questrade, Questbank, Questrade Wealth Management, Community Trust Company, Zolo, and Flexiti, provides securities and foreign currency investment, professionally managed investment portfolios, mortgages, real estate services, financial services and more. We use cutting\-edge technology to help Canadians become much more financially successful and secure.
  
At QFG, we combine human\-centric collaboration with AI\-driven innovation to redefine financial services. The ideal candidate will be a catalyst for change, using AI to transform and deliver unparalleled customer experiences and shaping a future where AI empowers our teams to do their best work.
  
Join our diverse, inclusive, and hybrid workplace to unleash your creativity and nurture your curiosity without limits. If you share this sense of infinite possibility, come shape your future at QFG.
  
  

What’s in it for you as an employee of QFG?
  
* Health \& wellbeing resources and programs
* Paid vacation, personal, and sick days for work\-life balance
* Competitive compensation and benefits packages
* Work\-life balance in a hybrid environment with at least 3 days in office
* Career growth and development opportunities
* Opportunities to contribute to community causes
* Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment


This job posting is for an existing vacancy
  
  

We’re looking for our next Director, FP\&A. Could It Be You?
  
The Director, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) is a key leadership role within the Finance team, designed to deliver insightful financial information and strategic analysis to the Executive Team and Board of Directors. Contributing directly to the success of Questbank and Questrade Financial Group, this role leads the business case and investment process, budget and forecast functions, and comprehensive management reporting. The Director plays a pivotal role in tracking headcount investments and overall financial performance while leading precise, fact\-based upfront analysis for upwards of $100MM in new yearly initiatives, ensuring alignment with both short\- and long\-term corporate strategic objectives.
  
  

Need more details? Keep reading…
  
**In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:**
  
* Leading the development, monitoring, and reporting for all business cases within the organization. Oversee precise and fact\-based upfront analysis, ongoing monitoring, and reporting to the executive team for upwards of $100MM in new initiatives annually to ensure success.
* Directing and driving the preparation and consolidation of the annual budget and monthly rolling forecasts. Collaborate closely with division leaders to ensure all assumptions are tested and vetted properly, ownership exists at the division level, and consensus is gained to align on organizational goals.
* Leading the comprehensive monthly review of consolidated financials against the budget. Provide in\-depth analysis to division leaders and the executive team focusing on KPIs, key ratios, and delivering value\-added commentary on next steps to keep the company on track for its long\-term strategic goals.
* Driving rigorous financial modeling for all acquisitions and special projects. Work closely with corporate development to ensure detailed and accurate models covering organic growth, acquisition\-related growth, integration economics, income statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and covenants, enabling Senior Management to make informed decisions.
* Being responsible for all management reporting to division leads, the executive team, and the board (including Management Reports, Journey Reports, business KPIs, key ratios, corporate scorecards, and MD\&A) against the budget, forecast, prior year, prior month, and the 5\-year plan. Ensure consistency across corporate and business unit reporting.
* Serving as the primary FP\&A system lead, driving continuous improvement and automation in financial processes, reporting frameworks, and data integrity.
* Partnering with senior leadership, Treasury, and Risk Management to ensure financial reporting consistency, liquidity tracking, and holistic strategic decision\-making support.
* Structuring, managing, and mentoring the FP\&A team to align with corporate requirements. Set clear performance objectives, provide regular feedback, and foster a high\-performance culture.


So are YOU our next Director, FP\&A? You are if you…
  
* Have a Post\-secondary degree/diploma in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
* Have a completed CPA or equivalent accounting designation
* Have 10\+ years of experience in the financial industry
* Have 5\+ years of experience in a similar FP\&A role
* Have 5\+ years in a management role
* Have advanced financial modeling, budgeting and analytical skills.


Additional kudos if you…
  
* Have experience in financial services, wealth management, or banking (highly beneficial for Questbank).
* Have experience with enterprise FP\&A and ERP systems such as NetSuite or Oracle EPBCS (Hyperion)


Sounds like you? Click below to apply!

jobs.description:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada
**Hours:**

37\.5
**Line of Business:**

Marketing
**Pay Details:**

$155,000 \- $215,000 CAD
TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job\-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.


As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.


**Job Description:**

Reporting to the Vice President, Growth Marketing, the Associate Vice President, Digital Performance Marketing leads the strategy, execution, optimization and performance of the digital marketing practice. The role provides enterprise and business leadership for digital marketing, connecting marketing strategy to measurable client and business outcomes.  



  

  

**Key responsibilities include:**

  

**• Digital Performance Marketing Strategy \& Execution –** Set and direct digital marketing strategy; establish channel roles, investment principles and execution standards aligned to business priorities.


**• Digital Marketing Leadership \& Standards –** Provide leadership across digital marketing channels, embed enterprise best practices and measurement standards, and build the digital marketing capabilities required to create competitive advantage.


**• Generative AI \& LLM Visibility Strategy –** Establish and execute TD’s enterprise Generative Engine Optimization and AI search visibility framework, including standards for how products, brand and advisory content are structured and represented within AI\-assisted discovery experiences.


**• Enterprise SEO \& Owned Content Discovery –** Lead organic search and owned content visibility across business segments; unify specialist teams under one technical mandate and establish shared priorities, methods and performance measures.


**• Technical Search Architecture –** Partner with Marketing Technology, Digital Experience, Content, Data and Technology teams to improve structured data, schema markup, site taxonomy, crawlability, indexing and domain authority.


**• Content Signals \& Authority –** Define enterprise standards that strengthen content quality, relevance, provenance and authority for both search engines and AI systems while supporting clear, accurate customer information.


**• Agency, Platform \& Vendor Leadership –** Lead relationships with agencies, media and technology platforms, and other vendors as extensions of the team, with clear expectations for performance, transparency, controls, innovation and value realization.


**• Planning, Investment \& Delivery –** Translate marketing strategies and annual plans into executable digital programs with clear targets, offers, timelines and budgets; steward investment and delivery to improve efficiency/effectiveness and achieve on\-budget outcomes.


**• Emerging Discovery Intelligence –** Monitor changes in search behaviour, answer engines, LLMs and digital discovery ecosystems; translate external shifts into actionable enterprise growth, content and experience strategies.


**• Performance Management \& Executive Advisory –** Provide ongoing insight into digital marketing performance relative to plan, forecast, prior year and competitive benchmarks; translate results and channel dynamics into clear decisions, trade\-offs and actions for senior leaders.


**• Governance \& Risk –** Establish controls, measurement and escalation practices for search visibility, content accuracy, brand representation, privacy and regulatory considerations across evolving discovery platforms.

That data powers three systems: **Graphite**, our identity resolution engine that ties fragmented consumer data into a single verified identity across retailers; **IRIS**, our fraud and returns\-abuse detection engine built on top of it.



You'll own the ML organization behind all of it — the models, the platform they run on, and the people who build them. For this role, you should be located in Canada and able to work within EST/EDT OR PST hours. We are fully remote.

* Build and grow a high\-performing, globally distributed team of ML engineers; hire, coach, and develop senior ICs and managers
* Set the technical bar for how models get built, evaluated, deployed, and monitored — and hold the org to it
* Push identity resolution coverage, precision, and profile classification accuracy against a measured, frozen\-holdout baseline — not against vibes
* Own IRIS model performance end\-to\-end: detection rate, false\-positive rate, label quality, and the feedback loops that keep both honest as fraud patterns shift
* Build the ML platform layer — feature stores, training pipelines, model registry, online serving, drift and performance monitoring — so model velocity isn't bottlenecked on infrastructure
* Partner with the AI engineering team so identity and risk signals are first\-class inputs to NAVI's agent decisions
* Work directly with Product, Engineering, Security, and Customer Success to translate messy retailer problems into ML problems worth solving — and to say no to the ones that aren't
* Own build\-vs\-buy and data\-partner decisions (third\-party identity data, enrichment providers), including the economics
* Communicate model performance, risk, and tradeoffs credibly to executives, retailers, and the board

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------



We care more about **judgment and ownership** than credentials.



You're likely a strong fit if you:


* Have 12\+ years in engineering with 5\+ years managing ML or data teams, including managing managers or senior ICs
* Are an engineer at heart — you can still read a training pipeline, review a feature spec, and tell when an eval is measuring the wrong thing
* Have shipped ML systems that make consequential automated decisions in production, and have owned them after launch — drift, retraining, incidents, and all
* Have deep experience with at least one of: **entity resolution / identity graphs**, **fraud and abuse detection**, **risk scoring**, or **anomaly detection at scale**
* Understand what makes ML different from software: labels are noisy and delayed, systems fail silently, offline metrics lie, and last quarter's model is fighting last quarter's adversary
* Have opinions about evaluation — precision/recall tradeoffs on heavily imbalanced data, holdout hygiene, feedback loops where the model's own decisions contaminate future labels
* Have built or scaled ML infrastructure: feature pipelines, training orchestration, online model serving with real latency budgets, monitoring and alerting
* Are fluent in Python and comfortable in a modern data stack (Spark, Airflow or equivalent, streaming, cloud data warehouses — we run on GCP)
* Have hired well, retained well, and can point to engineers whose careers got better on your watch
* Excel in a fast\-paced environment with a flat structure — you set direction by earning trust, not by mandate
* Have a BS/MS in computer science, statistics, or an equivalent background

**Bonus points**
----------------



These aren't hard requirements, but strong indicators:


* You've worked on identity resolution or graph systems against third\-party consumer data (credit bureau, telecom, or similar), including the matching logic and confidence scoring underneath
* You've operated adversarial ML systems where attackers actively adapt to your detection
* You've built real\-time inference paths where identity or risk has to be resolved inside a request budget
* You've worked in retail, payments, fintech, insurance, or marketplace trust \& safety
* You've partnered closely with LLM/agent teams and understand how structured ML signals ground agentic decisions
* You've navigated privacy, consent, and data\-governance constraints on consumer identity data
* You've done 01 — stood up a function, a platform, or a data partnership from nothing
* You use modern tooling (including AI\-assisted development workflows) to increase leverage, not outsource thinking

**Why ML at Narvar?**
---------------------



Because the data is genuinely rare and the problems are genuinely hard.


* **The dataset is a moat.** Cross\-retailer visibility across 20B\+ orders means we can see coordinated fraud patterns no single retailer can — a returns abuser hitting five brands looks like a good customer at each one.
* **The problem is adversarial and unsolved.** Returns fraud and policy abuse are growing faster than retail itself, and the counterparty adapts. There is no off\-the\-shelf answer.
* **The stakes are measurable.** Fraud loss, false\-positive cost, identity coverage, resolution rate. Not vanity metrics.
* **It feeds something bigger.** As AI shopping agents enter commerce, every agent will need a trust layer for returns, claims, and delivery promises. Identity and risk are that
